headline: Solara Active Pharma Sciences: Conversion of Partly Paid-Up Rights Shares into Fully Paid-Up Equity Shares
sum: Solara Active Pharma Sciences has converted partly paid-up rights equity shares into fully paid-up equity shares following receipt of call monies under its rights issue, a routine post-allotment regulatory disclosure.
implication: Rights issue conversions are mechanical post-allotment events triggered by receipt of call money; the structuring and gating occurred at issue launch, not here-this disclosure reflects completion of the subscription mechanism.
detail: Solara Active Pharma Sciences Limited, a manufacturer of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and specialty chemicals, conducted a rights issue offering partly paid-up equity shares to shareholders. Upon receipt of call monies from subscribers, the company converted those partly paid-up shares into fully paid-up equity shares, a mandatory step under the allotment and call mechanism. The conversion was reported to the National Stock Exchange (NSE) as a regulatory update on 19 August 2026. This is a standard post-rights-issue compliance filing, not a funding event itself.
